data.define: To study many things quickly just before a test.

misuse.why: Cramming only works for short tests.

data.l1_hook: Mai thi rồi. Tui chưa học gì hết!

native.tip: “cram” = Học nhồi nhét. Ví dụ: “I must cram for math.”
native.caption:
